speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss, along with an enlarged lymph node. To better understand the cause, can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present? Also, have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any recent fevers or noticed any pain in your abdomen when you drink alcohol? I would also like to request a CT scan of your chest, abdomen, and pelvis to evaluate the extent of the lymph node involvement.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: I will perform a physical examination to assess the consistency of the lymph node and check for hepatosplenomegaly. REQUEST TEST: Excisional lymph node biopsy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Patient
text: I have smoked about one pack a day for many years, and I drink socially. The abdominal discomfort and fatigue have both been getting worse. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Tuberculosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Excisional lymph node biopsy.
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray.
REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_CT.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Cervical Lymph Node Biopsy: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20. Chest X-Ray: Not available in provided data. Abdominal CT: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy confirms a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, likely Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, given the CD20 positivity and high proliferative index. I will now order further staging tests to determine the extent of the disease. REQUEST TEST: PET-CT scan. REQUEST TEST: Bone marrow biopsy.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative bone marrow biopsy and PET-CT suggest limited disease spread, confirming the diagnosis of Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma. I will proceed with initiating R-CHOP chemotherapy to treat the malignancy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
